description: This file implements the XCastManager class, which manages casting services, including application control, device configuration, and communication with external services like gdial. It contains methods for initializing, shutting down, and handling application state changes, as well as managing device properties and network configurations.

classes.name: XCastManager
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing casting operations, device configuration, and application control within the XCast ecosystem.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequestWithLaunchParam
methods.description: Callback for application launch requests with parameters, forwarding to observer.

methods.name: onApplicationLaunchRequest
methods.description: Callback for application launch requests, with special handling for Netflix app.

methods.name: onApplicationStopRequest
methods.description: Callback for application stop requests, with special handling for Netflix app.

methods.name: onApplicationHideRequest
methods.description: Callback for application hide requests, with special handling for Netflix app.

methods.name: onApplicationResumeRequest
methods.description: Callback for application resume requests, with special handling for Netflix app.

methods.name: onApplicationStateRequest
methods.description: Callback for application state requests, with special handling for Netflix app.

methods.name: onStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when the GDial service stops.

methods.name: updatePowerState
methods.description: Updates the power state of the device.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the XCastManager with network and device configurations, setting up gdial service.

methods.name: deinitialize
methods.description: Destroys the gdial service instance.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the XCastManager singleton instance.

methods.name: getReceiverID
methods.description: Retrieves the device's receiver ID from system files or device properties.

methods.name: getWiFiInterface
methods.description: Gets the WiFi interface name based on build type.

methods.name: getGDialInterfaceName
methods.description: Determines the GDial interface name based on system files or environment variables.

methods.name: envGetValue
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the device properties configuration file.

methods.name: applicationStateChanged
methods.description: Notifies the gdial service of application state changes.

methods.name: enableCastService
methods.description: Enables or disables the cast service for a given friendly name.

methods.name: updateFriendlyName
methods.description: Updates the device's friendly name in the cast service.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the protocol version used by the cast service.

methods.name: registerApplications
methods.description: Registers a list of applications with the cast service.

methods.name: setNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Sets the network standby mode for the device.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of XCastManager.

methods.name: IsAppEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific application is enabled in the cast configuration.
